The growth pair's diagonal info_sum is comparable to alpfe's, which looks like it refutes 'unobservable' - but diagonal self-information measures SENSITIVITY, not separability. The unobservability claim is an off-diagonal / eigenstructure statement and lives in the peraoi rank and GN sloppy eigenvector analyses.

A sweep arm can silently run as a duplicate of another. arm0_sst was intended as an SST-channel arm but its recorded env_extra_channels is empty, so it ran as the plain base config and its per-seed outputs are byte-identical to A_dustW0 - two rows of a 15-run table that are the same run. Separately, three covar2 arms were cancelled at epoch ~250/2000 and produced 0/10 seeds.

verify_run's per-parameter printout reported the joint CELL-WEIGHTED metric, which straddles: scav_rat read 10/10 there while the honest per-AOI ≥2-of-3 grader gave 0/10 on the same run. Reading the wrong line of a passing gate produces a fabricated recovery. (The 2026-07-29 session hardened the file so per-AOI leads and cell-weighted is marked [DO NOT QUOTE].)

Reading the cell-weighted recovery number instead of the per-AOI one. Up-weighting subsurface iron makes cell-weighted scav_rat look like it improves 7/10 -> 10/10 -> 10/10 while the honest per-AOI number collapses 9/10 -> 5/10 -> 1/10; the grader flagged straddle +5 and +9. The cell-weighted mean lands near Carroll precisely because the per-AOI legs sit on opposite sides of it.

Treating a conditioning gain as a recovery gain. Subsurface [DFe] takes the {alpfe, scav_rat} GN-Fisher condition number from 3022 to 2.2 (~1400x), which reads as a decisive information win - and forcing the recovery loss to exploit it makes recovery strictly worse. Information the Fisher sees is not necessarily exploitable by the fit.

Deleting the probe script after the run. The surrogate box Jacobian (the entire section-3 table) was computed by an uncommitted scratch file whose cluster copies were removed afterwards, so the numbers exist only as a markdown table with no re-derivation path. Commit the probe, or the result is unreproducible. (Lesson applied 2026-07-25: the replacement obs-operator probe is committed.)

A v05 perturbation ensemble that edits the data.darwin generation scalars would burn 17 GCM runs and test NOTHING, because DARWIN_READ_TRAITS silently overwrites them. The only proof an edit took is grepping the echoed &DARWIN_TRAITS block in STDOUT.0000 and seeing your value there — not 0.0418860 (the frozen original) and not 0.04245 (the generation scalar).

Benchmarking a learned CLOSURE against a FORECASTER's baseline (AR(1)) on a FORECASTER's metric (1-step). That is a category error in the evaluation, independent of whether the closure is good. Also: a reframe with no new metric is rebranding - the closure framing is legitimate only if it ships with a discriminating test the operator can pass or fail.

Quoting Mogen 2023 (10.1029/2023EF003605) or Krumhardt 2020 (10.1029/2020GB006531) exact horizon numbers. Both are paywalled (HTTP 402) and were read from abstracts/snippets. Their QUALITATIVE claims are corroborated by open-access companions and safe to assert; the exact numbers are not verified.
Staking anything on the Deng-Hani-Ma 'Fields Medals, ICM 2026' attribution. It is a forward-looking claim we do not verify. Cite the mathematical content only.

Converting Carroll-6 parameter posteriors into a Pg C/yr regional flux-error number. Flagged as the single easiest place in the positioning to overreach - it requires a forward UOSSE that has not been run. The strongest published bound remains biology ~2% of the long-term DIC increase.

Pairing the -2.47 +/- 0.50 Pg C/yr sink number with the GHG Center's 2020-2022 COG window. The sink figure is Carroll et al.'s 1995-2017 multidecadal validation result, not a statistic of the visualized 3-year stack. Keep them attributed separately or the pairing is a reviewable mismatch.
Running 50 seeds in one process. It CUDA-OOMs. n>=50 must be 5x 10-seed array blocks pooled into one OUTPUT_DIR.

Trusting verify_run exit 0 as proof the right config ran. Reproducing the flagship from the appendix config row alone silently omits POSI_W=1, USE_EPPLEY_T=1 and the per-AOI weights, giving scav_rat and the trio 0/10 instead of 8/10 - and BOTH the right and wrong runs pass verify_run.py at exit 0. verify_run gates the numbers, not the recipe. Use scripts/configs/flagship_geo1.sh.

Quoting a cell-weighted count as recovery. It overstates the per-AOI metric via a STRADDLE (per-AOI legs on opposite sides of Carroll whose weighted mean lands near it) - by +5 to +10 seeds for scav_rat. The obs-only scav_rat cell-weighted 40/50 is the canonical case: all 50 seeds land Cal+ in exactly ONE AOI (always southernoceanpac), so no 2-AOI majority ever forms. The grader flags straddles explicitly.

Fallback shims that validate nothing hide conformance bugs. With earth2studio absent, the batch_func decorator is a no-op, so tensors kept whatever rank the test happened to use (rank 4) and everything passed - while the real 6-D path was indexing 'time' as if it were 'variable'. The tests proved the code RUNS; they never proved it CONFORMS. A green CI run is not evidence of conformance when the extra is missing.

Sending a drafted collaborator email. docs/findings/2026-07-25_jon_gcm_ensemble_ask_DRAFT.md is a DRAFT that was never sent and carries an explicit 'Leave the To: line until ready'. The standing rule is draft, never send.

A session's whole executable deliverable was blocked because the required caches (geo1 .pt + GEOTRACES) live only on AICR, which is interactive-only behind Duo 2FA, while the reachable cluster carried only the unrelated emulator cubes. Check where the data lives before planning the run.

Cluster capacity was planned against unverified figures — '/projects/schultz has 3.3 PB' (really 36 TB, 8.2 TB free) and 'home 111 TB free' (really a shared filesystem, not a quota) — and separately a whole ensemble was assumed compute-blocked and needing NASA plus a collaborator, when live read-only checks showed it was self-runnable with resources already in hand.

Perturbation-deck values were transcribed into a recipe table instead of computed from p0, introducing a wrong value (alpfe ÷1.1 recorded as 0.844100 rather than 0.843918). Only writing a generator that derives from p0 surfaced it.

A quantity correct in one place, misapplied in another. The repo's 2930 was read as kappa(J) and squared again, producing a headline hypothesis ('0.29 surviving float32 digits, numerical annihilation') that was wrong by four orders of magnitude — while the same note's own caveats section already said the number came from the Fisher analysis. The fact was in hand and used incorrectly anyway.

Assuming a same-named parameter in another BGC model is comparable. Check the OPERAND before proposing a cross-model parameter comparison - BLING's scavenging constant multiplies FREE Fe, Darwin's multiplies TOTAL DFe. This killed an entire planned independent-validation route.

Reading the observation-design / Fisher numbers as fit results. They are single-seed (N=1), at Carroll theta, with epochs=0 - a Fisher-geometry calculation at the published optimum, and local at that theta. A strongly misspecified model makes local sensitivity a weaker guide, which is itself part of the eqpac argument.

A coverage test that asserts only 'this dataset covers SOME registered AOI' will confirm whatever subset happens to be on disk. The GP15 test asserted sum(counts.values()) > 0, which passed on npac 50 / npsg 25, and three zeros in the flagship AOIs were read as an observing-system FACT rather than as a staging gap. The filename literally said 'leg1' and answered the question; nobody looked. Cost: a published finding in PR #204 and commit 1e4b9ac that had to be fully retracted. Rule: test the data against the CAMPAIGN it claims to represent, not against itself.

load_scavenging_anchor defaults to phase='T' (total). In eqpac that yields THREE surface points out of 67, versus 64 dissolved-phase points spanning 20-5340 m. Wiring the anchor into the loss with the default would give an almost-empty anchor in the one basin that matters, with NO error raised. Pinned by test_the_dissolved_phase_is_the_usable_one.

Assuming the canonical-number guards catch every spelling. Flagship per-AOI scav_rat was written as 26 in one table (correct: 25) past two existing guards, and STATUS.md carried legs 8/19 (correct: 7/20). Re-derive canonical numbers from the grader, not from prose.

Citing a number whose artifact does not exist. Four diffusion claims cite JSONs that are ABSENT (`diff_surf.json`, `diff_3d.json`, `diff_daily_eqpac.json`, `matched_k1/k8.json`, `opt_physics.json`) and are unassertable; the log-space and AR(1) numbers were prose-only until re-fetched from the cluster. A finished run is not banked until it is in a committed file.

Generalizing a property from the tracers that have it to all of them. The log-space fix conserved mass for DIC and ALK only (<0.1%) while Chl1 drifted +129.7%, and three public documents credited it with mass conservation across all six tracers. Positivity and mass conservation are different properties.

Stating a data product's capability from its documentation prose instead of its file listing. Four walk-backs in a single scoping loop: GP15 coverage, BLING comparability, TPOSE iron availability, and B-SOSE extent. 'Prose describes what a system contains; the file listing describes what you can actually have.' Open grid.nc / the directory index BEFORE writing anything up.

A bound whose own hypotheses are never checked can survive for weeks as 'the project's dominant error channel'. The kappa^2 tan phi claim rested on tan phi, which was one forward pass away and was never measured; when measured it turned out to be either ~0.002-0.023 (term dormant) or >=7e5 (bound vacuous). Rule: before quoting a perturbation bound, measure the quantity that decides which of its terms is active.

A grader that used a literal p = 0.000 for a measured zero baseline made any nonzero count infinitely significant - it reported Biggrow 6/50 as 'decisive, P = 1.6e-17' when the honest answer is P = 0.078, not above chance. Zero-count baselines must floor at the rule of three (3/N) and the applied floor must be printed in the header.

A rate limiter that persists time.monotonic() to a lock file and compares it across processes hangs after a reboot, because monotonic has a per-boot epoch: stored 227759.1 vs current 175111.2 implied a sleep of 52648 s = 14.6 hours. Compounding it, a previous session had patched the uv CACHE rather than the source, and that patch itself referenced an undefined _tempfile_shim.

Grading a covariate-channel result against a different-architecture untrained baseline grades it against the wrong null. Adding the MLD channel alone raises alpfe's chance rate 10/50 -> 16/50 with NO training. Every covariate experiment needs its own architecture-matched prior control; this is now a documented requirement in CONTRIBUTING.md.

Probing directory URLs on a single-page app returns HTTP 200 for ANY path including nonsense ones, so a 'verified: inputs are public, no auth' decision rested on no evidence. Count real download= entries and confirm with an actual byte fetch (a range request returning HTTP 206).

Putting one chance column beside counts drawn from three different experiments - different n, different AOI scope, and in one case SYNTHETIC data - was an error in presentation. Biggrow 0/7 was the synthetic silicate_scope sweep, Smallgrow natl 9/10 was the n=10 seasonal prototype (single AOI, Chl-only, simplified trainer), diatomgraz 35/50 was job 190529, and the n=50 flagship grades only the TRIO.

Reading the cell-weighted count instead of the per-AOI one manufactures results that do not exist. In the observations-only run scav_rat reads 40/50 cell-weighted and 0/50 per-AOI, because every seed lands Cal-grade in exactly one AOI (always southernoceanpac) so no 2-of-3 majority ever forms. The trio is likewise 24/50 cw vs 0/50 per-AOI.

Cross-referencing two numbering schemes without checking they are the same table. Whether Carroll 2020's experiment numbering (#3-5, #7-11, #13) maps one-to-one onto the Table S1 rows in the Menemenlis 2019 deck is NOT verified - they may be different tables from different model versions (v4 in the deck).

Provenance strings were written into the canonical results matrix without ever checking that the files exist. Six of them do not — and only a from-disk audit nine days later caught it, after a workshop-paper decision had already been made on those numbers.

A truncated units attribute in a NetCDF file - literally 'mol Fe/' rather than 'mol Fe/m^3'. The MITgcm convention yields physically sensible values (0.165 nM), which corroborates but does not prove the reading, and a wrong unit here is a 10^3 error. Call it out rather than assuming it away.

Product metadata quoted from a conference slide instead of the distributed files: the B-SOSE row (equator to 78S, 2013-2021, ~6 yr overlap, ~2 deg at the equator) survived two rounds of correction before anyone opened grid.nc, which says 29.79S to 78S, 2008-2012, coarsest 0.300 deg, no tropical data at all. Read extents off the file you will actually use.

Reading a product's spatial extent and resolution off a solution page instead of the distributed file. The resulting committed claim ('equator to 78S', 'telescopes to 2 degrees at the equator', 'coarser than our 1 degree') was wrong in every column - and that note had itself been filed as a correction.

A fix designed and applied to ONE analysis path but never wired into its sibling. Biome fixed effects were added to calcite_driver_scout.py:69-89 explicitly in response to the reviewer panel's Simpson critique, and the correlation analysis was corrected — but the power-law exponent path was never updated, and nearly emitted a sign-inverted IDENTIFIABLE verdict as a result. When a pathology is found, grep for every estimator subject to it.

Auto-generated remediation advice that is INVERTED for the estimator it is attached to. 'Widen the visited Omega range' is correct for a per-AOI fit and actively counter-productive for a pooled fit, where the cheapest way to widen span is to add basins — which increases the between-group confound. Check that a tool's recommendation matches the scope it was emitted at.

Re-derivation that is not reproducible from the repository alone. The calcite per-point (Omega, ratio) pairs live in gitignored data/{daniels,marsh}/*.tab and D:\ecco_darwin_v5\cache\*.pt, so sections 3a/3b/3e/3f of the pooling finding cannot be checked by anyone without that machine. Only the convex-hull test and the gate re-application run on committed JSONs. State which parts of an analysis a reader can verify.

Reading n=10 counts as rate estimates against n=50: arm C's scav_rat 7/10 sits above the flagship's 25/50 purely on seed luck (the AICR flagship-full n=10 gave 9/10 against the same 25/50). The only comparison a 10-seed screen is powered to make is control-against-test WITHIN the screen.

Measuring the untrained null for ONE selected config. The flagship n50e2k_percell_trio was chosen out of a sweep over env-var levers, epoch budgets, AOI weights and channel choices, so the correct null is best-of-sweep under untrained networks - re-run the config-selection procedure inside each null draw. Our null answers 'chance for a fixed pipeline'; the claim it defends is 'chance for a pipeline we selected'. Named as the criticism that would hurt most.

Writing 'we introduce' or 'methodological contribution' anywhere near the untrained baseline or the identifiability contract. Both are refutable in one sentence by any referee who knows Adebayo et al. 2018. Concede the operation, keep the application, name the parents first.

The reproducibility appendix delegates to covar_env_common.sh, which lives only at ~/emulator_poc/ on the AICR cluster and is not in git (re-verified: git ls-files has no such file). A reader outside that account gets NO ERROR - the run simply trains without POSI_W and reports trio 0/10 instead of 8/10. Always publish recipes read back out of a verified run artifact, not transcribed from prose.

verify_run.py passed at exit 0 a run whose declared DANIELS_RPICPOC_W=1 anchor was silently skipped (PANGAEA file unstaged, one [warn] line, zero cells in every AOI), reporting R_PICPOC at 0.20-0.26x Carroll. The gate now fails runs whose declared weight got zero cells, but the general shape of the failure - the config a run DECLARES is not checked against the config it RAN - recurs.

A CRLB computed as diag(inv(Fn + ridge*I)) with ridge = 1e-6 * lambda_max CANNOT report a value above 1/ridge, so any 'constrained ~10^6 times more tightly' ratio is reading the regulariser floor, not a measurement. Caught same-day before use. Rule: for null directions, quote 'unconstrained, at the ridge floor', never a ratio.

Assuming a fresh worktree has observational data. `data/` is gitignored, so every real anchor degrades to a warning rather than an error. Stage the anchors (the runner prints the PANGAEA curl for Daniels) before trusting any local reproduction.

Treating `verify_run.py` exit 0 as proof the declared loss terms ran. A holdout run declared DANIELS_RPICPOC_W=1, the PANGAEA file was unstaged, the anchor was silently skipped with only a `[warn]`, and the gate returned exit 0 [VERIFIED] (10/10 seeds) on a result at 0.20-0.26x Carroll. The two keys that would have caught it were both already in the run JSON.

Assuming a retraction reached the collaborator. The particulate:dissolved iron retraction was propagated to STATUS.md and the solution map but was NEVER sent to Jon - checked by grepping the most recent Jon-facing document for particulate/partition/pFe/Fe_TP (zero hits). Internal propagation is not communication.

Grading a covariate arm against a different-architecture baseline. Adding a DINN input channel changes the chance rate with NO training at all - untrained alpfe goes 10/50 to 16/50 and untrained diatomgraz reaches 34/50 on the MLD channel alone. Any covariate comparison graded against a non-matched null is graded against the wrong null; this is why several published numbers were downgraded.

Inconsistent statistical floors inside one document. The evidence log states the rule-of-three floor as 3/50 = 0.06 at lines 329-330 and as 3/30 = 0.10 at line 570; the tables use 0.06. Also, three documents still carry the RETRACTED '(scav_rat, W_SINK) are perfectly degenerate' claim (2026-07-09_track2_identifiability_writeup.md:179, 2026-07-10_jon_decision_brief.md:78, scripts/iron_partitioning_controls.py docstring 13-15).

Quoting an epoch-mismatched control. The R_PICPOC anchor-off number is 6/50 at 2000 epochs (n50e2k_anchor_off, epoch-matched to the flagship) and 4/50 at 1500 epochs (n50_anchor_off). docs/findings/2026-07-22_anchors_only_n50_verified.md still cites the 1500-epoch 4/50 against the 2000-epoch flagship.

Sending the per-cell vs global-scalar contrast (trio 25/50 vs 0/50, R_PICPOC 50/50 vs 0/50) as support for regional rain-ratio variation. It is an identifiability fact about our estimator, not a measurement that the true ratio varies. The legitimate regional evidence is Daniels (eqpac ~1.6x global) and Sarmiento 2002 (20-30x).

Answering the wrong model generation. A question about data.darwin / data.traits (Darwin 3 namelists) was answered with a Darwin 1 / v04 finding about parameters hardcoded in source - even though the repo's own inventory states the distinction at ecco_darwin_parameter_inventory.md:125-127. Caught only by an adversarial validation pass before it went out.

Nearly reporting a non-bug to a collaborator on the strength of a secondary source. The claimed 'out-of-bounds write' at R_PICPOC(8) was a CONDITION on the loop variable, not an assignment; no memory is touched. Built on our own inventory doc rather than the Fortran.

A STRADDLE flag that fires only when cell-weighted minus per-AOI > 0 is silent whenever reverse seeds cancel straddling ones - archived example: cocc_c scav_rat has 2 straddling and 2 reversing seeds, both rows print 7/10, no flag, exit 0. Tolerable for a marginal count, not for a JOINT one, because cancellation permutes which seeds pass. Related open item: flags never touch the exit code, so a straddling run is still blessed under a gate-on-exit-0 convention.

Quoting a CRLB as a ratio when it sits at the ridge floor. `CRLB = diag(inv(F + ridge*I))` with ridge = 1e-6*lambda_max caps an uninformative direction at 1/ridge, so the column-OSSE's 4.2e6 means 'unconstrained', not a 10^6-fold precision gain. Standing rule: quote 'unconstrained, at the ridge floor', never a ratio.

The mirror-image error: quoting the rule-of-three FLOOR where a measured sample already exists systematically understates the evidence. It happened to flatter us (binomial 0.078 vs Fisher exact 0.0133 on the anchor-off control) but will not always. Standing rule: when a baseline is measured as a sample, compare samples.

Attributing a REPRODUCTION run's count to the published flagship. ctrl_n50's scav_rat is 26/50; the flagship n50e2k_percell_trio is 25/50. The same hazard applies to LEG tallies: §3.1d's R_PICPOC legs (47/50, 50/50, 40/50) and scav_rat legs (8, 19, 49) are ctrl_n50's, while the flagship's own are eqpac 7 / natl 20 / SO 49. This exact conflation drifted across TWELVE documents in July and took two audits to undo. The repo guard test_no_tracked_doc_binds_26_of_50_to_the_flagship now catches it.

Interpreting a number AFTER the fact. The project was twice saved by a control written down in advance (the CHL2_W_EXTRA P2 discriminating prediction, and the log-scale A/B falsification condition) and once embarrassed by a post-hoc interpretation (diatomgraz 35/50). Fix the decision rule before the data exists, with timestamps and a zero-JSON directory listing as proof of priority.

Quoting CELL-WEIGHTED counts inverts the sign of real results. In obsonly_mld_litic scav_rat reads 21/50 cell-weighted against 0/50 per-AOI, Smallgrow 41/50 versus 6/50, and Biggrow 27/50 versus 3/50. Anyone quoting cell-weighted from that run would report an observations-only iron result and two growth-parameter results that DO NOT EXIST.
Summing per-term observation counts double-counts co-located cells. 178 absolute-anchor observations is a per-term sum; the UNION is 112 of 2851 ocean cells (3.93%).

Writing a mechanism paragraph before reading the code. The '94% of cells are shape-constrained only' argument was written first and the loss checked afterwards; it is WRONG for four of six parameters because the PINN term is dense and absolute (run_v3.0_joint_multi_aoi.py:1755-1771). Check the loss before theorising about it.

Reporting a count without its architecture-matched untrained baseline. diatomgraz needs 40 of 50 to say anything at all while R_PICPOC needs 7 - a fact about the BOUNDS, not the ocean. Baselines must be real pipeline runs at NB23_LR=0, NB23_N_EPOCHS=1, n=50, verify_run exit 0: prior_mld_n50 for 2-channel/MLD arms, prior_ctrl_n50 for 1-channel arms.

A 0.30-dex threshold was quoted repeatedly as the identifiability precondition for IRON when it is a distill_powerlaw default belonging to the CALCITE branch. The iron branch has no span parameter at all. Reusing a numeric threshold across code branches without reading which function it belongs to would have green-lit an expensive fit on a support already shown to fail.

A refuted number (diatomgraz 35/50, P = 0.447 against an architecture-matched untrained 34/50) stayed live in STATUS.md, docs/index.md and a draft AGU abstract. Retracting a claim in a findings doc does not propagate it to the places people actually read.

An audit produced the exact replacement text for a tracked overclaim (2026-07-19_doc_claim_sweep.md:703-705) and the fix was never applied. Nine days later the original sentence was still live on disk and was the single most citable-against-us line in the repo. Writing the fix is not applying it.

An entire analysis's supporting body of work sat uncommitted on main (modified CONTRIBUTING.md, verify_run.py, carroll6.py, networks.py, run_v3.0_joint_multi_aoi.py, plus untracked test and analysis scripts), with both evidence documents themselves untracked and nothing through PR or bot review — so none of it was citable.

A hidden assumption inside the QUESTION. Asking 'is B-SOSE's TRAC06 total or free iron' presumes TRAC06 is a B-SOSE label. It is a generic MITgcm ptracer slot index that lands on iron in both models only because both list iron sixth - and under BLING v1 the same slot would have been DOP.

Treating 'N of N files downloaded, zero wrong-size' as a completeness check. It compares downloads against the manifest they came from and structurally cannot see records absent from the iteration grid — 64-69 per variable were, and the 7-way intersection lost 468 of 9860. Verify against the GRID, not against the manifest.

Two 'conflicting' statements that were both correct under different conventions. 'Daily era ends 2018-12-31' (interval-end stamp) vs 'ends 2018-12-30' (last day averaged) burned effort as a contradiction until a .meta sidecar was read. When an off-by-one appears in a time axis, check stamp-vs-window before assuming one side is wrong.

A 12-agent, 2-stage design workflow COMPLETED (12 of 12 agents, ~290 KB of costed design plus recomputed cost audits) and the launching session then hit 'Prompt is too long' and was archived having consumed only three incidental facts. The rest sat unread on disk until recovered days later, and recovering it needed no re-run — the payload was read back out of the run journal. A finished run is not banked until it is in a file.

A significance figure (P = 4.6e-08) was quoted using a chance rate measured on a DIFFERENT pipeline — 0.120 from the time-mean production run, job 227777 — than the seasonal arm being tested, whose own null has never been measured. This directly violated the project's standing rule that no count is reported without its architecture-matched untrained baseline, and that rule is exactly what would have caught it.

Treating an existing artifact as a free result that settles an open question. The handoff note called reading daily_train.json a free result; it was contaminated four ways and never measured the bar it needed to clear. Read the artifact's own config block before quoting its headline.

A scoring tool's constant drifted away from the trainer's while its comment still claimed they matched: emulator_baselines_v2.py clips at a fixed LOG_EPS = 1e-12 while emulator_poc.py moved to a percentile-based per-channel floor. Every log-space number the scorer produced for a channel with non-positive cells was systematically harsher than the trainer's.

Quoting all-cell log-space skill (-4.0031 overall, -33.97 / -16.51 / -226.57 per channel) as if it measured model quality. Those are dominated by clipped non-positive cells, each sitting 20-25 log units from the median. Use the strictly-positive subset instead - and note that subset is GENEROUS to the model, since it removes exactly the cells it got most wrong.

Scoring a log-space metric with a hard clip. emulator_baselines_v2.py clips at LOG_EPS = 1e-12 with a comment claiming it matches emulator_poc.LOG_EPS; it no longer does, because emulator_poc.py moved to a percentile-based per-channel floor. The scorer's log numbers are systematically harsher than the trainer's for any channel with non-positive cells, and all-cell log skill is dominated by clipped cells.

The trainer reports +0.22 and the scorer -0.32 for the SAME run, and both are correct: emulator_poc floors the log at a percentile of the positive train values (3.60e-05 for surfChl1) while emulator_baselines_v2 still floors at a hard 1e-12 with a STALE COMMENT claiming the two match. Not merely a rescaling - the direction is not neutral, and the scorer's floor favours persistence. Filed as issue #215 BEFORE these runs existed and still not fixed.

build_log_mask matches the channel-name STEM literally. This cube's channels are surfChl1..surfChl5, not Chl1..Chl5, so the DEFAULT --log-tracers list would have matched NOTHING and silently trained in linear space - reproducing the exact run the experiment existed to beat, with no error. Names must be passed explicitly and a post-training assert must confirm the transform engaged.

A pre-registered aliasing gate read 1.000000 and looked like a hard veto. It was an artifact of our own zero-init readout: gauge-fixing the same closure on the same data drops it to 0.3078. A number that flips from FAIL to PASS under a pure reparameterization was never measuring the ocean.

Designing architecture before checking the algebra. Five of six independent UDE design angles re-encoded a degeneracy that follows in two lines from S = r0*g being homogeneous of degree one in r0 - a check requiring no data and no run. The screen cost 13 agents and 1.99M tokens to reach a conclusion available by inspection.

Letting a metric that moves under reparameterization carry a veto. corr(level, readout bias) = 1.000000 read as a hard FAIL against a pre-registered 0.95 gate, but it was an artifact of zero-init readout and flipped to 0.3078 under a pure reparameterization. Gauge-fix by construction instead of measuring the gauge.

Since 2026-08-02 a CONSTANT readout in ScavClosure is normalised away to G == 1 exactly. So a synthetic-twin test that builds its 'truth' by perturbing only the readout BIAS produces a truth identical to the untrained closure, and the test then passes while comparing nothing. Perturb a readout WEIGHT (shape) instead, and assert the twin's field actually differs from the untrained one before fitting.

Scoring emulator arms in their own working spaces. Skill is computed in each run's working space, so a logged channel's number is log-space skill and a linear channel's is linear-space skill - exactly where the log-tracers hypothesis lived. The first, uncontrolled attempt would have been misleading in whichever direction it happened to fall. Rescore ALL arms in common spaces, and always name the space: the winning baseline itself changes (ar1_seasonal_percell in linear, anomaly_persist in log).

Deriving a time, a date, or an averaging window from a v05 MONTHLY .meta. Only 10.3-10.6% declare a full month and the declared window drifts -0.710 d/yr. Use t = iter * 1200 / 86400 days after 1992-01-01. timeStepNumber is reliable, timeInterval is not - and the asymmetry matters: DAILY .meta files ARE self-consistent.

Treating agreement between two independent data stagings as confirmation of a downstream consequence. Both stagings agreeing on the -0.710 d/yr metadata drift established the DEFECT was upstream, which felt decisive - but agreement on the metadata says nothing about the arrays. The decisive test needed a second independent rendering of the same field, and the daily archive already was one.

An aggregate count that hides WHICH region carried it. scav_rat's 0/50 per-AOI headline was read as 'nothing recovered' for months; grading each AOI leg against its own architecture-matched untrained null showed the southernoceanpac leg at 42/50, 39/50 and 50/50 against untrained 0/50. A majority rule can hide a decisive single-region result in either direction.

An aggregate per-AOI majority hid the opposite of what it appeared to say: scav_rat's 'observations-only 0/50' was a 2-of-3 majority artifact, not a measurement that nothing was learned — it recovers at 42/50, 39/50 and 50/50 in southernoceanpac against untrained 0/50. Always grade each leg against its own null before concluding a parameter is unrecoverable.

The verify_run gate could not certify the one loss term an entire investigation thread rested on: _TERM_CELL_KEYS covered nine terms but not geotraces_w or geotraces_sub_w, and the run JSON recorded no per-AOI GEOTRACES cell counts at all. A gate that passes on the terms you are not testing is not a gate.

Declaring loss terms a basin has no cells for. The OBSONLY config declares DANIELS_RPICPOC_W=1.0 and POSI_W=1.0, but southernoceanpac has zero Daniels and zero POSi cells, so both were silently skipped; verify_run returned exit 2 (DISCREPANCY) and a completed 50/50 job (237913) became unreportable, forcing a full re-run (238079). The inert-term check added 2026-07-29 caught exactly the failure it was built for.

Four graders hardcoded the >= 2 (2-of-3 AOI) rule, so any single-AOI run would have returned 0/50 for every parameter regardless of what it actually recovered. Fixed the morning of 2026-07-30; a single-AOI run needs the 1-of-1 rule.

Grading against a namelist value that is parsed but never integrated. v05 data.darwin:53 sets val_R_PICPOC=0.04245 next to the other Carroll-6 names, which looks authoritative, but under v05's compile flags the value is unreachable and the model runs on data.traits' 0.041886. The runtime handle that settles it without reading Fortran is darwin_traits.txt, written after both the namelist read and the hasPIC gate.

Post-hoc curve matching on two points. The 1/f R_PICPOC bias law fit BETTER with the wrong phytoplankton grouping (Chl1+Chl2, eqpac 1.955 vs measured 1.518) than with the correct one (Chl2+Chl3, 4.329) — a good fit to an assumed mechanism is not evidence for it when the sample is two basins.

Post-hoc curve-matching on two anchored points. The 1/f law for the R_PICPOC per-AOI bias fit well under the ASSUMED calcifying grouping (Chl1+Chl2) and fell apart under the SOURCE-VERIFIED one (Chl2+Chl3): eqpac goes from 1.955 to 4.329 against a measured 1.518. Two basins carry the anchor and the third has zero Daniels cells, so there was never enough to fit.

Post-hoc matching on two points: 1/f_large appeared to predict the R_PICPOC bias magnitude under the WRONG PFT grouping (Chl1+Chl2) and fit worse under the right one (Chl2+Chl3, eqpac overshooting 2.9x). A relationship that fits better before you check the source is a warning, not a result. Likewise the n=3 cross-AOI correlation of +0.83 must not be quoted.

A run declared loss terms that had zero cells in the target AOI, so they were silently skipped — the run was not the config it declared. verify_run caught it at exit 2 even though a seed-for-seed comparison later showed the numbers were bitwise identical. The artifact must say what the run did, so the declaration had to be corrected rather than explained away.

Declaring loss terms that have zero cells in the AOI. The OBSONLY config declared DANIELS_RPICPOC_W=1.0 and POSI_W=1.0 while southernoceanpac has zero cells for both, so the terms were declared and silently skipped - verify_run failed at exit 2 (job 237913). The re-run with both weights at 0 gave BITWISE IDENTICAL numbers across all six parameters and all 50 shared seeds (max relative difference 0.000e+00), so the numbers were never wrong and the gate was still right to refuse them: the artifact must say what the run did.

Re-deriving the GHG Center assessment. The standing verdict - the ECCO-Darwin CO2-flux product is NOT scientifically useful to us (single derived variable, 2020-2022 with zero overlap with our 1992-2018 archive, and it is ECCO-Darwin's own output so checking it against ECCO-Darwin is the model validating itself) - is recorded in two docs and the 2026-07-31 finding says explicitly 'That verdict stands and should not be relitigated.'

A warning banner in the reproducibility appendix did NOT stop the flagship recipe being re-typed by hand - it was followed anyway on 2026-08-01, a second time, costing a 30-task array. Prose does not prevent this class of error. The guard has to be executable: an sbatch-level assertion that exits 3 on config drift, plus a test that any training sbatch claiming the flagship sources flagship_geo1.sh.

N_STEPS was recorded in NO run artifact before 2026-08-02, so the arms of an integration-window sweep were indistinguishable on the one variable the sweep varied. Fixed by recording n_steps and dt_days in the artifact config block. Any window analysis over artifacts written before that date must recover the window from the output directory or the job log, not from the artifact.

scripts/configs/flagship_geo1.sh exported USE_MLD_CHANNEL and USE_AOI_ID_CHANNEL until 2026-08-02. Those are the runner's internal PYTHON identifiers; its environment variables are MLD_CHANNEL and AOI_ID_CHANNEL. Nothing read the USE_* spelling, so those two lines pinned nothing - inside the file whose header promises that setting defaults explicitly stops a future default change from silently moving the flagship. Guarded now by test_flagship_config_guard.py, which requires every exported name to be read somewhere in scripts/ or src/.

Artifacts have NO bare `joint` key on a param entry. The keys are joint_recovered, joint_cellweighted_recovered, joint_aoiweighted_recovered, joint_geom_cellweighted_recovered, joint_median_pooled_recovered, joint_abs_rel_offset, joint_band, joint_carroll_published, per_aoi_recovered (+ _geom, _median) and per_aoi_log_sd. Reading .get('joint') returns None for every parameter and silently compares nothing - which is how a reproducibility certificate came to be issued on an empty set.

Do NOT quote the maximum |rel_offset_A - rel_offset_B| between two replicate runs as the drift. It was 0.218 in the measured pair while the underlying value drift was 1.7%, because a unit recovered far from Carroll has a large rec/carroll, so a small RELATIVE change in the recovered value is a large change in its rel_offset - while sitting nowhere near the decision boundary. Compare each unit's drift to its OWN margin.

Black et al. (2020) Supporting Information Table S1 carries the PER-STATION georeferenced Fe export values (the committed CSV has only per-study/province ranges, n=20). The Wiley host is behind a Cloudflare interstitial and returns a 'Just a moment...' challenge to automated fetches, so it cannot be retrieved programmatically. The paper is open-access CC-BY-4.0 - download S1 by hand if per-station coverage is needed to rescue E3.

Do NOT propose daily v05 data for the parameter learner. It is settled and closed on three independent grounds: daily v05 is surface-2D only (16 diagnostics, none of the 3-D tracers the loss uses); the anomaly variance fraction is the same daily as monthly; and daily lag-1 r of 0.994-0.996 collapses the effective sample size. Daily adds cadence, not information.

E3 (wire the 210Po/210Pb + Fe-export sink anchors into the loss) is recorded as 'the highest-value item in the document' and predicted to be the only intervention able to move eqpac - but the iron-side data has ZERO eqpac coverage, so that specific prediction is untestable. Do NOT conclude the experiment is dead: GP15 sits inside npac (92 points, 6 stations) and npsg (48, 5), both already defined in AOI_BY_KEY, so re-scope it to a single-AOI run where the data lives. CHECK OBSERVATIONAL COVERAGE AGAINST THE TARGET AOI BEFORE IMPLEMENTING, and check it against EVERY defined AOI before declaring an anchor unusable - a loader existing is not evidence the data reaches the basin, and missing your intended basin is not evidence it reaches none.

Do NOT read the scav_rat row of the bounding-map A/B on its own. The geometric map raises scav_rat's UNTRAINED rate from 0/50 to 8/50 (measured twice, jobs 263466 and 264591, and pooler-invariant at 8/8/8), so part of any marginal gain is prior rather than learning. Read the TRIO, whose untrained baseline is 0/50 in BOTH arms under ALL THREE collapses and is therefore immune to the prior shift.

A missing collapse key is a blocking UNKNOWN, never a silent fallback to the arithmetic number. Runs before 2026-07-29 record only per_aoi_recovered, and 119 of 211 run dirs are in that group. Reading the absence as 'the pooler does not matter here' is the same absent-is-not-equal fallacy that produced the retracted code-regression finding. scripts/analysis/pooler_audit.py prints <absent> and exits 2 - treat that exit code as a gate.

Claim ids (ind342, abd555, ...) are NOT stable. gen_research_map.py sorts claims by (status, statement) and research_map_db.py numbers them positionally, so adding one claim -- or changing one claim's status -- renumbers every claim after it alphabetically. A trial insertion of 7 claims changed the meaning of 328 of 563 existing ids. Before adding CLAIM rows, check whether the id stability defect is fixed; SUPERSEDES / SETTLED / TRAPS rows are prose-keyed and safe to add.

Do NOT propose EKI/CES (or EnKF, history matching, KOH GP emulators, SINDy) as a way to improve scav_rat recovery. It is settled that no ESTIMATOR breaks the rank-1 alpfe<->scav_rat null - only a new OBSERVABLE that projects source and sink differently does. EKI's role is diagnostic: it reproduces the backprop verdict without autograd, and its scav_rat estimate of 0.349x Carroll is the independent check that the arithmetic collapse was inflating, not evidence that a better estimator is available.

so_only and so_only2 are ONE result, not two. All 50 seeds are bitwise identical; the danielsW/posiW difference is inert in that single-AOI configuration. Citing both as agreement is citing the same fit twice, and the Southern Ocean scav_rat claim therefore has no replication.

Planning GPU work on the assumption that more cells cost more time. A DINN fit is LAUNCH-BOUND: 2,853 to 105,300 cells is 38.5 to 42.4 ms per epoch at 200 steps on an H200. Grid size is nearly free; only step count and epoch count cost. Do not reach for a bigger cluster to fit more cells.

Hiding an on-support mask. Report off-support extrapolation error separately and explicitly labeled - a reviewer panel will flag a hidden mask. Also: equifinality is invisible to within-trajectory time splits, so you must hold out a whole REGIME, not a time slice.

Using trajectory MSE as the success criterion for closure recovery. A 10,718x MSE drop sat alongside a 293% closure error, and the bias-inheritance result (arXiv 2604.01335) says low-excitation data attains SMALLER trajectory loss yet WORSE closures. Report trajectory MSE only to demonstrate the decoupling.

Reading a synthetic self-twin as science rather than as a machinery test. A per-cell env closure recovers by env-interpolation regardless of transport, and the K_num ablation is non-discriminating on it (delta flat at 1.306 -> 1.307 across kh 50 -> 800). Also: spatial blocking is not an env-regime hold-out for a per-cell env closure.

Assuming forward accuracy certifies invertibility. An FNO at state R2 ~0.986 can sit at Jacobian R2 0.21-0.82, with multi-parameter inversion below 0.64. A gradient-based calibration loop run on such an emulator is ALSO actively driven off-support by the optimizer (the neural-adjoint boundary-loss failure mode) - the spatial re-incarnation of the box's negative-R2 trap.

Citing a study for the method it superficially resembles. WOMBAT was carried as the SBI affordability anchor when it is a GP-surrogate + emcee MCMC calibration (~512 sims) - methodologically route (A). The one concrete number that made SBI look cheap did not support SBI at all.

A control that is toothless under the conditions it actually ran in. The K_num ladder was designed to catch numerical passes ASSUMING transport moves the scored cells; transport is inert in this rollout, so the ladder is trivially flat (0.332/0.294/0.314) and 'shrinks' fired only because the last value came in below the first after a dip. A nominal E2 PASS rested on that flag.

Binned positives on tiny n that invert under an environment-source swap. A +0.69 hold-out R2 on 26 binned cells, permutation-significant at p=0.006 and surviving BH-FDR, was a Simpson's-paradox-like aggregation artifact - point-level correlation is 0.011, and the two environment sources agree only r=0.24 at the same cells. FDR correction and a permutation null were both present and neither caught it.

'The emulator is shelved' was recorded without scope, and the shelving covered only the parameter-conditioned CALIBRATION emulator — the forward/OSSE emulator had been greenlit and had already passed its beat-persistence PoC. A scope note had to be retrofitted to the doc. Record what a shelving decision does NOT cover at the moment it is made.

Conflating two scopes of the calcite result. The SCALAR R_PICPOC is already recoverable; what is untestable is whether an environmental driver MODULATES it. Keep them separate or the identifiability-limits result reads as 'R_PICPOC is unrecoverable', which is false.

Quoting the '32x' iron flat-band multiple as if it were threshold-independent. It is 25x / 32x / 100x at +0.01 / +0.02 / +0.05 log-MSE; the headline 32x is the +0.02 value. The specific multiple is a grid+threshold artifact - the FLATNESS is the load-bearing point. Likewise the 0.30-dex 'identifiability threshold' is a heuristic, not a power-analysis result.

Reading a pooled cross-basin exponent as a within-regime environmental response. Pooling raises the Omega SPAN (0.25-0.38 dex) but that span is between-biome contrast while each biome is <=0.16 dex, so the pooled fit is a Simpson slope across biomes sitting at different mean Omega AND different mean rain ratio. The within-basin Marsh slopes are significantly POSITIVE while the pooled GLODAP slope is negative - the sign disagreement is the signature of the artifact.

Load-bearing numbers that live only in stdout are not results. The iron 32x wall, the partitioning degeneracy, and the co-located coverage counts were all PRINT-ONLY until the 2026-07-10 audit-hardening pass forced committed JSONs and reproducers - and that pass is what caught the 'perfectly degenerate' over-claim. Still open in the same doc: e2_real_calcite_eqpac.py emits no committed JSON, fig3 is rendered from HARD-CODED LITERALS, the 10-seed per-seed record is local-only, and growth_npp_scout.py is still print-only.

Duplicating canonical numbers across documents. The 1-page Track-2 summary states explicitly that this de-duplication discipline exists because number duplication is what let the n=10 E2 update drift. State results qualitatively in summaries and cite the one doc that owns the number.

Reasoning from a plausible toy instead of the primary table burned a cycle: an intermediate 2-box model suggested the iron degeneracy needed a second sloppy direction and predicted ~16x inventory variance, but it also produced unphysical deep [Fe] of 400-6800 nM, and Tagliabue's own Table 2 shows inventory varies only 2.6x. Two agents also predicted the wrong fold change by using the dust-only ~30x source instead of the total ~140x - the fix was to check the denominator, not to invent a mechanism.

Agent fan-out for a question that inline WebSearch answers. The 2026-07-20 architecture scan was done with inline WebSearch and NO agent fan-out by explicit cost discipline; workflows are for external research only.

An experiment that cannot run because the data artifact is the wrong shape or off disk. The emulator geometry test (jobs 8512977/8512998) was inconclusive because the AOI cubes are non-geographic with an empty interior and cannot resolve coastal versus interior, and the global cube is off disk - leaving a headline claim ('the rollout ceiling is irreducible') contested rather than resolved.

Quoting a sloppiness magnitude from a saddle. The per-AOI CRLB gives ~3.96 decades in the Eq. Pacific, but the theta* Hessian carries a zero/negative eigenvalue, so theta* is not a clean minimum and the decade-span is not quotable. The qualitative rank structure survives; the number does not. Same root cause as the 07-19 audit, which records one negative eigenvalue at theta* in every run and 2-3 at Carroll's values.

Splicing two different metrics into one claim. 'scav_rat collapse 8/10 -> 0/10, p=7e-4' spliced a cell-weighted numerator onto a per-AOI denominator; restated under one metric it is per-AOI 25/50 -> 1/50 with Fisher p ~ 0.03. A referee will catch a metric change inside a single sentence.

Provisioning a cluster mid-session that has no repo, no venv and no data. On 2026-07-22 the H200/Explorer had idle nodes while the B200 was queue-jammed at 400+ pending, and provisioning Explorer would have cost more than it saved; the B200 backfilled and finished everything.

Reading a self-twin geometry result as real-data recovery. The two-anchor geometry break (|rho| 0.472 -> 0.061) is a self-twin, so scav_rat is already 20/20 at baseline by construction. It validates the identifiability GEOMETRY, not recovery, which still needs real 234Th/210Po data.

Showing docs/figures/emulator_globe_chl1.png. It predates the log-space fix (PR #193) and is contaminated by a real bug - 30.4% of predictions below zero, showing as white holes where the oligotrophic gyres should be. Its +0.664 'MAKE' headline was separately retracted against the per-cell seasonal AR(1) baseline. Regenerate before showing it to anyone.

Perturbing a v05 parameter that the runtime silently overrides. data.traits OVERRIDES generated R_PICPOC/PALAT/PCMAX (darwin_init_fixed.F precedence), so a perturbation ensemble on val_R_PICPOC, growth or palatability will do NOTHING unless the LOADED trait entries are perturbed and verified in the startup output.

Treating Darwin's own scvLosFe / scavRate diagnostics as independent evidence for scav_rat. They are runtime-selected (check data.diagnostics) and are SYNTHETIC targets from the same model. Model sink diagnostics establish implementation consistency only.

Validating a surrogate Fisher against raw GCM tracer fields. Perturbation fields must be pushed through the SAME depth/phase/location/timescale/uncertainty-weighted observation operators as the inverse problem; raw tracer fields alone do not validate it.

Inverting the finite-difference Hessian at Carroll's values for a CRLB. It is INDEFINITE, because Carroll is the global optimum and not each individual basin's minimum, so the inverse is invalid. Use the empirical Fisher (PSD) but read eigenVECTORS and the null space, not residual-weighted diagonal magnitudes.

Running a profile over a parameter whose channel is not in the loss. MLD is a DINN INPUT channel, and the profile evaluates L(theta) over a shared global theta[6] with training off - so a 'diatomgraz-profile-with-MLD' experiment would reproduce the MLD-off profile exactly. The MLD -> diatomgraz 10/10 result is a RECOVERY fact, not a LANDSCAPE fact, and must not be cited as the latter.

Grading against a null that is too weak. The Track-2 emulator's 'PIC/POC beat persistence' headline survived for weeks and died the moment a free per-cell seasonal AR(1) baseline was run (skill CI straddles zero, -0.16 worse than AR(1), robust across seeds 0-3). Pick the strongest cheap baseline BEFORE reporting skill.

Reporting an n=10 recovery count as a finding. scav_rat 9/10 from the flagship-full config triggered a whole reconciliation experiment and a proposed STATUS/accuracy-matrix rewrite before n=50 showed it was 26/50 seed luck. n>=50 before a count moves a claim.

Calling the >=2-of-3 metric 'co-recovery'. It requires no common AOI - a seed can count as a joint hit even if no single AOI recovers all three parameters. A referee will read 'co-recovery' as 'jointly identified in the same place', which the metric does not test, and since the paper elsewhere makes exactly the spatial argument, the non-co-located metric undercuts the mechanism it is meant to support.

Claiming Bonferroni survival without declaring the family. Flagship p=0.003 becomes 0.021 at m=7 (survives), 0.084 at m=28 (fails), 0.34 at m=112. Combined with the McNemar correction, the R_PICPOC anchor contrast survives no family larger than about m=3. Use Benjamini-Hochberg (these tests are strongly positively correlated across configs, so Bonferroni is the wrong correction), or better, lean the anchor claim on VALUE CONVERGENCE (per-AOI means going from scattered 0.006/0.061/0.075 to converged 0.052/0.052/0.048), which is subject to no multiplicity correction at all.

Fabricated citations survive unless someone opens the PDF. The sweep's own investigator agent invented the Kriest 2017 'difficult, if not impossible' quotation, which appears zero times in the paper. The adversarial pass caught it, and every blocker in the report was then re-checked by hand before being written down.

Quoting line numbers from a working copy. scripts/identifiability_sloppiness.py is 968 lines in the working copy with rel_span at :814 and thresholds at :836/:838, while committed HEAD puts the same code at :468 and :490-495. STATUS.md line numbers drift from uncommitted edits (the horizon row is :91, not :88). Re-anchor before quoting anything externally.

Reading identifiability maps off percell_crlb_map.py's error path. A bare except Exception fabricates lat/lon axes with the exact half-cell offset commit ac8af55 already fixed elsewhere - for eqpac, 21 cells of 0.95238 degrees starting at -4.5238, a 4.8% stretch. The guard checks axis LENGTH only, the map is saved looking entirely normal, and a single console line is the only signal.

Reporting a horizon as 'one step'. Our one step is ONE MONTH - roughly six Samudra steps in physical time. 'One step' invites the reading that the model dies after five days (harsher than the evidence) and must equally not read as competitive with a 60-day OceanNet horizon. Report the horizon in physical time everywhere.

Treating the reproducibility section of the 2026-07-25 sweep as verified. Its verifier agent (verify:repro-gaps) died on an API stall, so section 5 carries NO adversarial pass and must be treated as unverified leads.

Trusting the canonical grader's printed table. grade_recovery.py:123-126 silently drops an unparseable seed (bare except Exception: continue) and :227-231 lets the same corrupt file DISABLE the integrity gate, so it prints a complete, quotable per-AOI table with medians and a ridge verdict over a silently reduced seed set - only 'n=6/? gate: unavailable' distinguishes it. EXIT=2 does fire, so the verified-experiment discipline holds, but the line is easy to read past.

Using unpaired tests on identical seed sets. The epoch-doubling contrasts (scav_rat 25/50 -> 41/50, N. Atlantic 20/50 -> 40/50) share seeds, so they are PAIRED and need exact McNemar; the wrong unpaired Fisher values are p=0.0014 and p=8.3e-5. Also, Wilson under-covers at the 0/n and n/n boundaries where most counts live - use Clopper-Pearson or Jeffreys (0/10 -> [0, 0.3085], 10/10 -> [0.6915, 1.0]) - and do not call disjoint intervals 'the interval-form statement of the Fisher result'; non-overlap is strictly more conservative (Schenker & Gentleman 2001).

Building darwin3 / ecco_darwin on the Explorer LOGIN node. The start-here note flags it in capitals: BUILD in a Slurm job, not the login node. Also: de-risk with a minimal 1-baseline + 1-perturbation run before the full ensemble.

Quoting the per-AOI scav_rat legs from docs/research_notes/2026-07-25_next_session_start_here.md. It says natl 19->40 and eqpac 6/50; STATUS.md (lines 314, 362, 415) says natl 20->40, SO 49->48, eqpac 7->6. STATUS.md is canonical - the 25->41/50 total agrees in both.

Setting R_PICPOC via val_R_PICPOC in the Darwin namelists - it is OVERRIDDEN. R_PICPOC must go in the data.traits R_PICPOC array, and diatomgraz in data.traits PALAT entries 36 and 43 (only alpfe and scav_rat live in data.darwin &DARWIN_PARAMS). Verify each perturbed value actually loaded via the STDOUT.0000 grep protocol.

A sign typo in a derived objective hid a real failure mode: L = sum_g (m_g/2) log||r_g||^2 is unbounded BELOW as r_g -> 0 (an earlier draft wrote -log||r_g||^2, which tends to +infinity and would have been harmless). The model-vs-model Darwin-pattern block, fittable to far lower residual than any real anchor, would have swallowed the objective and starved the real anchors. Caught by review 2026-07-29, before implementation.

Fisher-matrix condition numbers are ALREADY kappa(J)^2. Treating the repo's published 2930 / 2.2 / 35-51 as kappa(J) inverted the central conclusion of an entire analysis section: eqpac went from 'inside the kappa-predicted band, therefore information-limited' to 'exceeds the worst-case bound by ~3x, therefore the one basin kappa demonstrably cannot explain'. The check that caught it was one line - re-deriving 2944 from the published eigenvalues 1.08e-3 / 3.18.

Prior work on this project produced a FABRICATED citation. The correct response is to treat every identifier as untrusted until re-fetched, not to omit it. No identifier was retrieved for GCV (Golub-Heath-Wahba), the Morozov discrepancy principle, the L-curve non-convergence results, Eckart-Young 1936, or Tikhonov-EKI (TEKI) - where those appear they are named as classical results with NO citation attached and must not be cited until an identifier is fetched.

Planning a v05 perturbation experiment by editing `data.darwin`. For R_PICPOC and diatomgraz that silently does nothing - DARWIN_READ_TRAITS (line 382) overwrites DARWIN_GENERATE_RANDOM (line 357). Only alpfe and scav_rat are editable there. Answering this precedence question once already 'saved a wasted perturbation experiment'.

Auditing the loss by variable name. The target key co2_flux_obs is assigned from ds_avg_local['CO2_flux'] - Darwin's own flux diagnostic, NOT an observation - and misclassifies loss terms 11 and 26. The key cannot be renamed (torch.save cache key, no version field, read outside the rebuild try). 10 local uses were renamed to co2_flux_darwin with three mutation-tested guards.

Citing numbers that no committed artifact backs. Four found in one audit: the box's negative held-out R2 is PRINT-ONLY (computed at runner:1971-1990, absent from the result JSON at :2073-2136, and a grep of docs/**/*.json returns nothing); covar_env_common.sh is not in the repo so the flagship's POSI_W=1 is inferred not read; the alpfe null hit-rate 0.47 exists only as prose in project_checkpoint_2026-07-25.md:31; and scav_rat per-AOI is 25 in some places and 26 in others (one is wrong by one seed).
Piping verify_run.py or pytest. A pipe masks the exit code, so the gate silently passes.

Re-deriving the observations-only design. The loss half of Jon's 'drop the ECCO-Darwin output' prescription was ALREADY implemented and ALREADY run twice (n=10 and n=50) under the different name *anchors-only*, with verify_run exit 0. Search for DARWIN_PATTERN_W and 'anchors-only' before scoping any observations-only work.

Claiming a Darwin-free or observations-only FIT. Darwin enters three ways and env vars remove only two: loss targets (removable), initial condition (removable via DARWIN_IC=0), and FORCING - SST, MLD, wind, SSS, apCO2 all from v05, plus Darwin SST and Darwin mldDepth as the DINN input channels. A repo-wide search finds NO observational MLD product (no de Boyer Montegut, no Argo, no WOA). 'Observations only' currently means 'observations-only TARGETS'.

Quoting a run that produced correct-looking numbers but failed the verification gate. Job 237913 gave counts IDENTICAL to the accepted run but exited 2 because the config declared DANIELS_RPICPOC_W and POSI_W on a basin with zero cells for either. The re-run (238079/238080) is bitwise identical, max relative difference 0.000e+00 - but quote the re-run, not 237913.

Reporting a property of the GRADING RULE as a property of the model. scav_rat was reported as recovering in 0 seeds because the per-AOI 2-of-3 basin rule cannot return a majority from one basin - while the Southern Ocean leg was actually recovering 39-50 of 50 against 0/50 untrained.

A Slurm job can report COMPLETED while doing nothing. Job 233168 exited 0 having produced no artifacts: an sbatch built inside a quoted ssh heredoc let $HOME expand on the WORKSTATION, so the job cd'd to a nonexistent path, never sourced the venv, died on ModuleNotFoundError: torch, and nothing checked the return code. Write sbatch files locally, pipe through tr -d '\r', and guard with an explicit import check plus exit $fail.

Editing a shared cluster tree mid-array splits the batch, because every task reads the tree at its own start time. Pin md5s that each task stamps into its own provenance header (networks b12ec42d, runner c6622e10), and run new code from a clone with a retargeted env script until the array fully drains.

Neither review bot's silence means clean: Codex was rate-limited on PR #208 ('reached your Codex usage limits for code reviews'), Greptile had not commented by session end, and no CI run was triggered at all - .github/workflows/tests.yml exists but gh pr checks 208 reports no checks. Check trigger conditions before relying on CI as a merge gate.

Queuing an array on an unsmoked code path risks losing the whole window on a task-0 crash. The POINTWISE smoke test took 27 seconds (job 233156) and validated the entire chain including JSON metadata.

A Slurm job can report COMPLETED while doing NOTHING. The first GN-Fisher job built its sbatch inside a quoted ssh heredoc, so $HOME expanded on the WINDOWS side. It cd'd nowhere, never sourced the venv, died on ModuleNotFoundError: torch, and exited 0. Fix: an import guard plus `exit $fail`.

Backpropagating 'failure configs' where failure means 'landed far from Carroll'. That is training on the answer and makes every recovery count circular. Physically-invalid failures are already handled by POSI_W and the PINN term. Also ruled out: gating the UDE on a 0.30 dex span (gate on aliasing correlation < 0.95 instead - 0.311 dex already failed at aliasing 0.9908), and using the per-cell-vs-global 0/50-vs-50/50 contrast as evidence that the rain ratio varies regionally in anything sent to Jon (that is a fact about our estimator; the Daniels 1.6x is the real evidence).
Backticks in `gh issue create -b` and `git commit -m` get command-substituted. This mangled issue #212 and silently stripped a word from a commit message. Use -F or a quoted heredoc.

Context overflow kills a session outright. The predecessor reached 1718 messages and returns `Prompt is too long` on every turn; /condense cannot rescue it because condensing itself needs a model turn that overflows. Write handoff notes BEFORE the ceiling, and expect transcript rendering to drop tool-call arguments (several items were UNRECOVERED).
Do NOT stage daily surfPCO2. Its fldList is `pCO2` and it is a 50-level BYTE DUPLICATE of the pCO2 directory despite the 'surf' name - 34.8 GiB for nothing. Monthly surfPCO2 IS genuinely 2-D.
Editing the source tree that Slurm arrays execute from (~/emulator_poc) hits any array task that has NOT started yet. Keep a second clone (~/emulator_poc_pw) so edits cannot reach a running array.

Existing 'global 1 degree' runs are NOT on a 1-degree grid. `--aoi-bounds -80,89.75,...` gives 171 rows at 0.998538 deg, never co-registered with bin_average or any satellite regrid. Also: /scratch/.../daily/v05_binavg_1deg.nc is MONTHLY despite the path name (276 steps, 1995-01 to 2017-12).

Honor explicit local-only markers on research notes. Several docs carry 'Uncommitted draft. Not pushed.' or 'Local-only doc; do not commit.' banners (2026-05-03_overnight.md, 2026-05-21_jon_meeting_brief.md). Separately and by later user directive, docs/paper/main.tex is LOCAL-ONLY and must never be git-tracked - note the 2026-05-23 cleanup audit predates that directive and recommends committing main.tex.
Land-mask bug: in these files land is 0.0, NOT -999. Use Depth > 0 (546,695 ocean cells -> 44,001 ocean bins, consistent with bin_average's 44,730). Caught before it corrupted a cube.

Portal listings truncate INCONSISTENTLY - two scrapes of the same directory gave max=355320 n=9796 then max=553824 n=7638. Never establish era or file count by scraping. Missing files return HTTP 500, not 404.

Re-downloading data that already exists. /scratch/qi_zim_neu/v05_daily (218 GB) duplicates /scratch/qi_zim_neu/daily_v5 (2.9 TB), and daily_global_halfdeg_cube.npz (42 GB) plus daily_global_1deg_cube.npz (13 GB) already existed before a ~9.1 GB cube was rebuilt. RULE: list /scratch/qi_zim_neu BEFORE staging anything.

Recursive-crawl downloading is ~55x slower than the manifest method: 45 files/min for a recursive crawl versus 2,481 files/min when you fetch each 4.1 MB index once, parse the explicit URLs, and download from the manifest.

The per-AOI majority rule has EIGHT implementations and two were wrong: grade_all_params.py:105 and contract_report.py:119 hardcoded >= 2, grading every SINGLE-AOI run 0/n; grade_all_params.py:192 had a backslash in an f-string (SyntaxError below Python 3.12). Duplicate grader logic is a standing hazard.
`pytest | tail` MASKS exit status in an && chain. Capture rc=$? directly.

apCO2 means DIFFERENT things in the two trees: monthly is EXFapco2 (atmospheric), daily is surfpCO2 (seawater). There is NO atmospheric pCO2 at daily cadence, and routing the daily tree through TRAC_MAPPING (src/darwindiff/llc270_loader.py:54-86) mislabels it.

verify_run.py STRADDLE flags are ADVISORY and never touch the exit code, so a run can exit 0 VERIFIED while printing a metric inversion. The inert-term check added 2026-07-29 does gate. There is still NO config-selection null.
Grading a PARTIAL arm as complete. n=50 per arm; if an arm is short, refill the missing blocks. The free-field ladder rung is at 40/50 with trio 0/40 and must reach 50 before being quoted.
